sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard the counsel for the petitioner.
Though notice is served on the complainant, none appears.
2. A private complaint is filed under Section 200 of Cr.P.C. before the Prl. JMFC, Raichur alleging the violation of the provisions of Section 31(1) of Food Safety and Standard Act of 2006.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Act of 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. According to the petitioners, the respondent being in-charge of the Health and Family Department, Raichur filed a complaint alleging transportation of 40 cans of 20 litres each drinking water, which had no ISI mark, and also no address was found.
Similarly, there were five bags containing 200 ML water pouches, each bag containing about 100 pouches.
The name of the manufacturer is shown as Lahari Flavoured Water Drink and Packers name is Sri Laxminarasimha Swamy Enterprises, Shia Talab, Raichur.
However, no batch number was printed.
According to the counsel for the petitioner, the unit is closed by the Government itself by seizing the factory.
There is no manufacture activity in the said factory.
As such, question of manufacturing and selling the alleged water cans by the petitioner does not arise.
Despite petitioner filed an application seeking permission to open the unit, the same has not been considered.
4. The submission of the counsel for the petitioner is that no such seizure panchanama was conducted.
Only such an allegation is being made.
5. There is no material produced by the complainant that the product being sold is injurious to health and also no seizure panchanama has been produced.
In the circumstances, mere filing complaint without there being any material needs interference.
Accordingly, petition is allowed.
Impugned proceedings initiated against the petitioner are quashed.
